scope: Android30012 source and native dependency manifests; preparation only, no Play form submitted

minimumDefiniteCollectionRows.basis: Persisted player displayName; Google Play definition explicitly includes nickname. Provider realname only processed transiently if present.
Random guest profile created automatically when initialize syncs online; stable profile/provider subject used for saved wallet and authentication, before any social login choice.
Chosen collection/difficulty/mode sent and persisted with prepared game tickets and profile-linked unlock state; no separate analytics instrumentation.
Google Play definition explicitly includes gameplay. Persisted rooms/game state, validated rewards and claim records are linked to profiles; gameplay proof validation prevents duplicate rewards.

authenticationEmailReview.basis: Native CredentialManager yields email and IDToken; full IDToken sent to server, verified then payload discarded, only subject persisted. GoogleSDK/provider retention must be separately confirmed before marking whole category ephemeral.

sharingReview.multiplayerNicknameAndGameState: User-initiated expected sharing with opponent; Google Play exception may apply
sharingReview.providerLogin: User-initiated OAuth consent; evaluate sharing exceptions and provider processing rather than assume every transfer is reportable sharing

securityAndDeletion.reason: BLE peer GATT framing has no app-layer encryption or explicit encrypted-write permission; assess user-directed peer-sharing exemption and radio link before claiming all flows encrypted.

importantDifferenceFromApple: Google Play counts off-device transmission, including transient processing in its main collection guidance. Current page FAQ has differing ephemeral wording; use canonical collection definition conservatively and review SDK retention. Apple label uses retention beyond servicing a request.
